assessment: The diagnostic is caused by JavaParser rejecting an explicit record accessor whose generic type differs only by a type-use annotation; its message formatter strips that annotation, making expected and found appear identical. The pinned source construct compiles in the minimal JDK probe. JavaIndex retains the parsed compilation unit when a parser problem exists, and the resulting graph still contains the PUT endpoint and its reach to the admin_settings table through updateSettings. This case therefore adds a false PARSE_ERROR finding but does not demonstrate lost HTTP extraction.
boundary: This review establishes a false-positive parser diagnostic for this type-use-annotation shape and confirms no loss in the inspected endpoint/reach path. It does not establish that every JavaParser validation problem is spurious, nor that the entire external application compiles; the foreign repository was not built.
